known_text: I want to give her more time.

use.known: I want to give her more time to think about it.
use.target: 我想给她更多时间来想。

use.known: That young man asked me if I know your sister.
use.target: 那个年轻的男人问我是不是认识你姐姐。

use.known: If the old woman can tell me, I would be very happy.
use.target: 如果那个老女人能告诉我的话，我会很开心。

use.known: Everyone told me they want to meet your brother too.
use.target: 大家都告诉我他们也想见你哥哥。

use.known: Would that young woman be able to help me with this?
use.target: 那个年轻的女人能帮我做这个吗？

use.known: She hopes I can remember what the old man said.
use.target: 她希望我能记住那个老人说了什么。

use.known: I want to give her more time to finish the work.
use.target: 我想给她更多时间来做完工作。

use.known: That young woman wanted to know what happened yesterday.
use.target: 那个年轻的女人想知道昨天发生了什么。

use.known: If you want to give her something, do it now.
use.target: 如果你想给她东西的话，现在做。

use.known: Your father wanted to meet your mother last night.
use.target: 你爸爸昨天晚上想见你妈妈。

use.known: Everyone here wanted to know when the work starts.
use.target: 这里的大家都想知道工作什么时候开始。

use.known: What did that old man want to tell you about?
use.target: 那个老人想告诉你什么？

use.known: I want to give her more time before the meeting.
use.target: 我想开会以前给她更多时间。

use.known: That young man wants me to give him the answer.
use.target: 那个年轻的男人想我给他答案。

use.known: If you can give me some time, I will help you.
use.target: 如果你能给我一些时间的话，我会帮你。

use.known: She told me to give your mother this book.
use.target: 她告诉我给你妈妈这本书。

use.known: Everyone is waiting for him to give us the answer.
use.target: 大家都在等他给我们答案。

use.known: When will your father give us something to read?
use.target: 你爸爸什么时候会给我们看的书？

use.known: I want to give her more time to learn.
use.target: 我想给她更多时间来学。

use.known: That young man asked if she can come to help tomorrow.
use.target: 那个年轻的男人问她是不是明天能来帮忙。

use.known: If she has time tonight, she will help us with work.
use.target: 如果她今天晚上有时间的话，她会帮我们做工作。

use.known: I want her to tell us what your mother said.
use.target: 我想她告诉我们你妈妈说了什么。

use.known: Everyone is waiting for her to give us the answer.
use.target: 大家都在等她给我们答案。

use.known: Would she be able to remember what happened yesterday?
use.target: 她能记住昨天发生了什么吗？

use.known: I want to give her more time to think carefully.
use.target: 我想给她更多时间来想好。

use.known: That young woman wants more people to help us.
use.target: 那个年轻的女人想更多人来帮我们。

use.known: If you need more help, please let us know now.
use.target: 如果你需要更多帮忙的话，请现在让我们知道。

use.known: She told me she wants to learn more about this.
use.target: 她告诉我她想学更多这个。

use.known: Everyone here wants more time to finish the work.
use.target: 这里的大家都想更多时间来做完工作。

use.known: How much more time does your father need?
use.target: 你爸爸需要更多多少时间？

use.known: I want to give her more time because she is busy.
use.target: 我想给她更多时间因为她忙。

use.known: That young man doesn't have time to help us today.
use.target: 那个年轻的男人今天没有时间帮我们。

use.known: If you have time tomorrow, we can meet and talk.
use.target: 如果你明天有时间的话，我们可以见面说话。

use.known: She told me she needs more time to finish the work.
use.target: 她告诉我她需要更多时间来做完工作。

use.known: Everyone here thinks we don't have enough time.
use.target: 这里的大家都觉得我们没有够的时间。

use.known: When will your mother have time to see us?
use.target: 你妈妈什么时候有时间见我们？
